proposals.before: The emperor praised his integrity and raised Feng's rank to grand coachman of the imperial household.
proposals.after: The emperor praised his integrity and raised Feng's rank to Grandee of Splendid Light.
proposals.reason: 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Light / palace grandee, not grand coachman of the imperial household.

proposals.before: The emperor praised his integrity and added Feng's rank to grand coachman of the imperial household.
proposals.after: The emperor praised his integrity and added Feng's rank as Grandee of Splendid Light.
proposals.reason: 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Light / palace grandee, not grand coachman of the imperial household.

proposals.before: Your Majesty did not measure your subject's ability yet appointed him metropolitan governor; he has had no way to prove himself, and you again raised your subject to grand coachman—office is lofty and responsibility heavy; it is not what your subject should hold.
proposals.after: Your Majesty did not measure your subject's ability yet appointed him metropolitan governor; he has had no way to prove himself, and you again raised your subject to Grandee of Splendid Light--the office is lofty and responsibility heavy; it is not what your subject should hold.
proposals.reason: 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Light / palace grandee, not grand coachman.

proposals.before: Fu Shang was the grand empress's half-brother and the nearest kin left.
proposals.after: Fu Shang was a son born of the same womb as the great imperial grandmother's father--her paternal uncle--and the nearest kin left.
proposals.reason: 皇太太后父同產子 means a sibling of the Empress Dowager's father, not the grand empress's half-brother.

proposals.before: The emperor's uncle Wang Li used Li Shang of Nanyang to grab hundreds of qing of marsh and wasteland, then asked the court to pay for it.
proposals.after: The emperor's uncle Wang Li used Li Shang of Nan Commandery to grab hundreds of qing of marsh and wasteland, then asked the court to pay for it.
proposals.reason: 南郡 is Nan Commandery, not Nanyang.

proposals.before: At that time the emperor's maternal uncle, Marquis of Hongyang Wang Li, had retainers acting through Administrator of Nanyang Li Shang seize several hundred qing of reclaimed grassland. Much of it was hillside and marsh that common people had leased from the Privy Treasurer—all was roughly developed—and they memorialized, wishing to turn it over to the commandery treasury.
proposals.after: At that time the emperor's maternal uncle, Marquis of Hongyang Wang Li, had retainers acting through Administrator of Nan Commandery Li Shang seize several hundred qing of reclaimed grassland. Much of it was hillside and marsh that common people had leased from the Privy Treasurer--all was roughly developed--and they memorialized, wishing to turn it over to the commandery treasury.
proposals.reason: 南郡 is Nan Commandery, not Nanyang.

proposals.before: Du Zhiji died the next winter.
proposals.after: Du Zhiji died the next year.
proposals.reason: 明年 means next year here; the literal translation already has this correctly, not next winter.

proposals.before: Later Guangwudi honored the family with a post for his grandson Kang.
proposals.after: In the Jianwu era, recording old virtuous ministers, the court appointed Bao's grandson Kang as a chief.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic invents "Guangwudi" and omits the Jianwu-era / recording-old-ministers wording present in the Chinese and literal.

proposals.before: It scolded him for haggling with the Fu palace over slave prices.
proposals.after: Long stands among the Nine Ministers yet has not corrected what the court lacks; instead he memorializes to wrangle with the Yongxin Palace over the price of slave-girls, stating it openly in memorials that everyone has heard.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits the edict content and replaces 永信宮 (Yongxin Palace) with the invented gloss “Fu palace.”

proposals.before: When Emperor Ai died and Wang Mang took control of the government, he had Grand Minister of Works Kong Guang memorialize that Long, formerly Shepherd of Ji Province, had handled the Zhongshan Empress Dowager Feng case unjustly and trapped the innocent, and therefore should not hold office in the central region.
proposals.after: When Emperor Ai died and Wang Mang took control of the government, he had Grand Minister over the Masses Kong Guang memorialize that Long, formerly Shepherd of Ji Province, had handled the Zhongshan Empress Dowager Feng case unjustly and trapped the innocent, and therefore should not hold office in the central region.
proposals.reason: Chinese 大司徒 is Grand Minister over the Masses, not Grand Minister of Works (大司空).

proposals.before: When Emperor Ai died, Wang Mang seized government and had Grand Minister of Works Kong Guang memorialize that Long, as former shepherd of Ji Province, had handled the Zhongshan Lady Feng case unjustly and trapped the innocent—he should not hold office in the central plain.
proposals.after: When Emperor Ai died, Wang Mang seized government and had Grand Minister over the Masses Kong Guang memorialize that Long, as former shepherd of Ji Province, had handled the Zhongshan Lady Feng case unjustly and trapped the innocent—he should not hold office in the central plain.
proposals.reason: Chinese 大司徒 is Grand Minister over the Masses, not Grand Minister of Works (大司空).

proposals.before: He Bing's grandfather relocated to Pingling on a clerk's salary.
proposals.after: He Bing, courtesy name Zilian, was a man whose grandfather moved from Pingyu to Pingling as a clerk at two thousand piculs.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits courtesy name 子廉 and the move from 平輿, both present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: He was transferred to governor of Yingchuan, replacing Yan Xu of Lingsyang.
proposals.after: He was transferred to governor of Yingchuan, replacing Yan Xu of Lingyang.
proposals.reason: Place 陵陽 is Lingyang, not Lingsyang.

proposals.before: Later Guangwudi honored a grandson with a gentleman appointment.
proposals.after: In the Jianwu era a grandson of Bing was appointed gentleman.
proposals.reason: Chinese 建武中 names only the Jianwu era; idiomatic invents the temple name Guangwudi.

decisions.reason: Chinese 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Light; “grand coachman of the imperial household” mistranslates a different office (太僕), and the proposed replacement is accurate.

decisions.after: The emperor praised his integrity and increased Feng's rank to that of Grandee of Splendid Light.
decisions.reason: 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Light, not Grand Coachman; 加秩 here increases Feng's rank to that grade.

decisions.after: Your Majesty did not measure your subject's ability yet appointed him metropolitan governor; he has had no way to prove himself, and you again raised your subject to Grandee of Splendid Light—office is lofty and responsibility heavy; it is not what your subject should hold.
decisions.reason: 復秩臣為光祿大夫 requires Grandee of Splendid Light, not grand coachman; keep the original em dash and wording around “office,” changing only the mistranslated title.

decisions.after: Fu Shang, Palace Attendant and Grandee of Splendid Light, was the Imperial Great Empress Dowager's paternal cousin. She had raised him from childhood, and no bond was closer.
decisions.reason: 父同產子 means the son of a full sibling of her father, making Fu Shang her paternal cousin rather than her uncle or half-brother. 小自保大 says she raised him from childhood.

decisions.after: At the time, the emperor's maternal uncle Wang Li, Marquis of Hongyang, had retainers use Nan Commandery Administrator Li Shang's influence to claim several hundred qing of uncultivated land. Much of it was marshland that the Privy Treasurer had leased to commoners and that they had already reclaimed. Wang Li then memorialized offering it to the government.
decisions.reason: 南郡 is Nan Commandery, not Nanyang. The fuller revision also preserves the commoners' prior leases and reclamation, which the draft omitted.

decisions.after: At that time the emperor's maternal uncle, Marquis of Hongyang Wang Li, had retainers use the influence of Li Shang, Administrator of Nan Commandery, to claim several hundred qing of uncultivated land. Much of it consisted of marshland the Privy Treasurer had leased to commoners, nearly all of which had already been reclaimed. Wang Li memorialized, wishing to transfer it to the government.
decisions.reason: 南郡 must be Nan Commandery. The revision also clarifies the retainers' use of Li Shang, the commoners' leases, and 略皆開發.
明年 means the next year; “next winter” invents a season absent from 明年，稚季病死.

decisions.after: During the Jianwu era, when the court honored ministers of former merit, Bao's grandson Kang was appointed magistrate of Zhu.
decisions.reason: The sentence names only the Jianwu era, not Guangwudi. 諸 is Zhu County in Langya and 長 is its magistrate, not a generic chief.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 建武中，錄舊德臣，以寶孫伉為諸長

decisions.after: Long ranks among the Nine Ministers, yet instead of correcting the court's failings, he memorializes to haggle with Yongxin Palace over the price of slave-girls, airing the dispute before everyone.
decisions.reason: The original omits the edict's charge and invents 'Fu palace' for 永信宮. The revision restores Yongxin Palace and condenses the public wrangling into natural English.

decisions.after: When Emperor Ai died and Wang Mang took control of the government, he had Grand Minister over the Masses Kong Guang memorialize that, as former Shepherd of Ji Province, Long had mishandled the case of Empress Dowager Feng of Zhongshan and entrapped innocent people, and therefore should not serve in the central government.
decisions.reason: 大司徒 is Grand Minister over the Masses, not Grand Minister of Works. 中朝 here is the central government, not a geographical region.

decisions.after: When Emperor Ai died, Wang Mang seized control of the government and had Grand Minister over the Masses Kong Guang memorialize that, as former Shepherd of Ji Province, Long had handled the case of Empress Dowager Feng of Zhongshan unjustly and entrapped innocent people; he therefore should not hold office in the central government.
decisions.reason: The literal likewise requires Grand Minister over the Masses for 大司徒, and 中朝 means the central government rather than the central plain.

decisions.after: He Bing, courtesy name Zilian, came from a family whose grandfather had moved from Pingyu to Pingling as a two-thousand-picul official.
decisions.reason: The sentence gives He Bing's courtesy name and his grandfather's move from Pingyu. The revision retains both facts without the draft's awkward 'was a man whose' construction.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 何併字子廉，祖父以吏二千石自平輿徙平陵

decisions.reason: 陵陽 is Lingyang; “Lingsyang” is a spelling error with no support in the Chinese place name.

decisions.after: During the Jianwu era, one of He Bing's grandsons was appointed a Gentleman.
decisions.reason: The Chinese names only the Jianwu era and identifies the appointee as He Bing's grandson; it does not name Guangwudi.
